job.job_description:
Technical Expertise (Must-Have): Backend: Advanced Microservices architecture, gRPC, HTTP REST, and Kafka for inter-service communication. Frontend Expert: Mastery of React (Web) and React Native (Mobile - iOS/Android) using Redux for complex state management. Database: Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL (AWS RDS), including schema design, migrations, and performance tuning.

Lead the resolution of critical L3 production issues and implement long-term technical improvements/refactoring.
Drive a "Security-First" approach, conducting code reviews and ensuring no shortcuts in data handling or privacy.
Design scalable APIs and manage complex third-party system integrations for SMS, Voice, and Email.
Take ownership of bug fixes, maintenance, and performance optimization across web and mobile platforms.
Execute custom feature developments using the agreed-upon tech stack and documentation standards.
Proactively flag issues early and provide time-zone flexibility for critical production coordination.

Experience: 2+ years of experience in full-stack development



Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
